steps.description:
A `First Name` is the only required(*) field.
Let's give this person a name.
steps.label: First Name
steps.title: First Name

steps.description:
Add a `Last Name`.
The `Last Name` field is required if you want to create a family from this person.
After saving, the `Full Name` shows as the title of the form.
steps.label: Last Name
steps.title: Last Name

steps.description:
`Membership` says how this person is connected to the church: `Member`, `Regular Attender`, `Visitor` or `Contact`.
Adding a `Membership` life event sets `Member` for you. Let's choose `Visitor` for now.
steps.label: Membership
steps.title: Membership

steps.description: `Status` is `Active` for everyone who still takes part in the church. Set it to `Inactive` when someone leaves, and give the reason. A `Death` life event sets it for you.
steps.label: Status
steps.title: Status

steps.description:
You can define `Church Position`s that this person has been or is currently assigned.
Go ahead and assign this person a 'Secretary' position starting today by clicking on the `Add Row` button below.
steps.label: Positions
steps.title: Church Position
